job.title: Brake Press / Punch Press
job.description:
Brake Press Operator

A Brake Press Operator is responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining a brake press machine to bend and shape metal sheets or plates according to specified dimensions and angles. They play a critical role in the metal fabrication process, ensuring accurate and precise bending operations to create various metal components and structures.

Responsibilities

Machine Setup and Preparation:

  • Review work orders, blueprints, or job specifications to understand bending requirements.

  • Select the appropriate tooling, dies, and backstops for the brake press machine based on the material type, thickness, and desired bend angles.

  • Set up the machine by installing and aligning the tooling and ensuring proper clearance for the workpiece.

  • Adjust machine settings, such as stroke length, ram speed, and backgauge position, to achieve the desired bending results.

Bending Operations:

  • Load the metal sheet or plate onto the brake press machine, ensuring proper alignment and clamping.

  • Input bending programs or adjust machine controls to specify the bending angle, bend length, and number of bends required.

  • Operate the brake press machine to perform bending operations, using foot pedals, control panels, or computerized controls.

  • Monitor the bending process to ensure accurate and consistent bends, making adjustments as necessary.

Quality Control and Inspection:

  • Perform regular quality checks to ensure the accuracy, precision, and quality of bent components.

  • Conduct dimensional measurements, angle checks, or visual inspections to identify any defects, deviations, or non-conformities.

  • Make adjustments to machine settings, tooling, or setup as needed to correct any discrepancies.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Adhere to safety protocols and use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) during all machine operations.

  • Follow machine-specific safety guidelines and standard operating procedures.

  • Participate in safety training programs and contribute to maintaining a safe working environment.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience in operating brake press machines or similar sheet metal bending equipment.

  • Knowledge of brake press setup, tooling selection, and machine programming.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, or bending specifications.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to produce high-quality bends within specified tolerances.

  • Good hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity.
